logos.name: Company logo (griffin + wordmark)
logos.treatment: Maroon background removed; single-color alpha mask recolored via CSS (maroon #5E000A in light mode, cream #FBEEDA in dark mode)

logos.name: V shield (avatar)
logos.treatment: Background removed; alpha mask; replaces full logo in frames under 230px tall

logos.name: Bravo! Winner badge
logos.treatment: Cropped to circle, 240px, CSS circular mask (no white corners)

accentColors.note: Skipped per customer; recognition has no warning states

branding.pattern: Brand Banner wing motif recreated as inline SVG pattern (banner image not embedded)

primaryMetric.label: Bravo! honors since 1999
primaryMetric.value: All-time count of winners and honorees in the roster (1,921)

secondaryMetrics.label: {quarter} honorees
secondaryMetrics.value: Winners in the featured quarter (12 for Q4 2025)

secondaryMetrics.label: Departments this quarter
secondaryMetrics.value: Distinct departments in the featured quarter (11 for Q4 2025)

secondaryMetrics.label: Years of Bravo!
secondaryMetrics.value: Latest year minus first year plus one (27: 1999 to 2025)

standard.trigger: employeeCode absent or not in featured quarter
standard.label: Q4 2025 Honorees

personalWinner.trigger: hash(employeeCode) matches a winner in the featured quarter
personalWinner.label: You're a Bravo! winner
personalWinner.behavior: Viewer's own card shown first with coral outline, one-time sheen and 2s status dot; their name starred in history

content.featuredCarousel: Featured quarter winners rotate every rotateSeconds, roster order
content.history: All other quarters, newest first, rendered in batches on scroll
content.privacy: Employee numbers never displayed; stored only as FNV-1a 32-bit hashes for matching

data.identityNote: Not location-scoped; same roster for every location. externalLocationId is read but unused.

customVariables.name: quarter
customVariables.displayRule: Pins featured quarter; accepts Q4-2025, Q4 2025 or 2025-Q4; invalid values fall back

data.dataSource: Static, embedded from Quarterly_Bravo_Recognition_Program.pdf (1999 to Q4 2025, 1,921 honors after cleanup)
data.refreshNote: 1000 ms tick drives the carousel progress; data itself is static
